name: Danchi Wife ~Hitozuma Nude Model no Kenshin~
original_name: 団地ワイフ～人妻ヌードモデルの献身～
source:
In this game, the protagonist is a shy and insecure young man. He lost his mother when he was a baby and never interacted much with women, since his family was just his father and two older brothers. To tell the truth, he avoids contact with women, due to being exaggeratedly shy. Since he is a loser and cannot even pass  the test to enter a University, his father sends him to Tokyo alone, to study in a preparatory school. Living on his own, the protagonist meets his two new neighbors: an energetic and happy housewife and a serious and lonely widow. 

Moreover, the protagonist wants to enter the arts University, but, because he is so shy with women, he cannot paint the nude models, thus not able to pass the entrance exam.

The protagonist needs to "train" his painting techniques and a model to pose for him in nude, so he can defeat his shyness. Which woman the protagonist will choose to help him out? This is your choice.

[Description by fhc]
translation:
本作主人公是一名害羞而缺乏自信的年轻人。他尚在襁褓时便失去母亲，家里只有父亲与两个哥哥，因此几乎没有与女性相处的经验。说到底，他因为过分害羞，总会逃避与女性接触。他不仅一事无成，甚至没能通过大学入学考试，于是父亲把他独自送到东京，就读补习学校。开始独居后，主人公结识了两位新邻居：一名精力充沛、性格开朗的家庭主妇，以及一名严肃而孤独的寡妇。

主人公希望考入艺术大学，却因为太害怕女性而无法画裸体模特，因此始终无法通过入学考试。

他需要“训练”绘画技巧，并找一名愿意裸体摆姿势的模特，以克服自己的羞怯。主人公会选择哪名女性帮助自己？选择权在你手中。

[简介由fhc撰写]
